build_truncated_bptt_lm_task: build a fairseq task for truncated BPTT language modeling with distributed data parallel support
create_token_block_dataset: create a TokenBlockDataset to chunk tokenized text data into fixed-size blocks for sequence modeling
load_dataset_split: load a train valid or test dataset split using the TruncatedBPTTLMTask load_dataset method
run_inference_step: run language model inference with prefix tokens and a custom BOS token via SequenceGenerator
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference from source tokens and lengths using build_dataset_for_inference
